paite: Huan Jesu'n anungzuite kiang ah, "Puknate om lou thei ahi kei; himahleh puknate omsakpa tung agik hi!
heading: Jesu Thugen Khenkhatte / (Mat 18.6-7,21-22; Mar 9.42)
english: He said to the disciples, “It is impossible that no occasions of stumbling should come, but woe to him through whom they come!

paite: Hiai mineute lak a khat leng hihpuk sang in, angawng ah buhgawina suang oksak in, tuipi ah kipaileh amah a ding in ahoihzaw ding hi.
english: It would be better for him if a millstone were hung around his neck, and he were thrown into the sea, rather than that he should cause one of these little ones to stumble.

paite: Pilvang un, na unau in thil ahihkhelhleh taihilh in; akisikleh ngaidam in.
english: Be careful. If your brother sins against you, rebuke him. If he repents, forgive him.

paite: Ni khat in na tung ah sagihvei thil hihkhial in sagihvei, ka kisik, chi a nang lam a ahong kihei nawnleh na ngaihdam ding ahi," achi hi.
english: If he sins against you seven times in the day, and seven times returns, saying, ‘I repent,’ you shall forgive him.”

paite: Huan sawltakte'n Toupa kiang ah, "Ka ginna uh khangsak in," achi uhi.
heading: Ginna
english: The apostles said to the Lord, “Increase our faith.”

paite: Toupa'n, "Ankam tang khat bang ginna na neih uleh, hiai singtheimi kung kiang ah, na kibotkhia inla, tuipi ah na kisuan in, na chi ding ua, na thu uh amang mai ding hi.
english: The Lord said, “If you had faith like a grain of mustard seed, you would tell this sycamore tree, ‘Be uprooted and be planted in the sea,’ and it would obey you.

paite: "Himahleh nou lak ah kuapeuh in lei let hiam, belamching hiam sikha nei unla, ahong vaipaitak in, an hong um pah aw, kua ahia nou lak ana chi ding?
heading: Sikha Mohpuakna
english: But who is there among you, having a servant plowing or keeping sheep, that will say when he comes in from the field, ‘Come immediately and sit down at the table’?

paite: 'Ka nek ding hon bawlsak inla, puan teng inla, ka nek a ka dawn zoh masiah ka nek bawl in; huai khit chiang in nang ne in dawn in, na lak ua kua ahia na chi zaw lou ding?'
english: Wouldn’t he rather tell him, ‘Prepare my supper, clothe yourself properly, and serve me while I eat and drink. Afterward you shall eat and drink’?

paite: Na thu bang ua ahih ziak in na sikha kiang ah kipahthu na gen ngei ua hia?
english: Does he thank that servant because he did the things that were commanded? I think not.

paite: Huchibang in 'Nou leng na kiang ua thupiak tengteng bang a na hih nung un, sikha phatuam lou ka hi uh, ka hih ding him uh ahi ka hih uh,' chi un,” achi hi.
english: Even so you also, when you have done all the things that are commanded you, say, ‘We are unworthy servants. We have done our duty.’”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Jerusalem kholam a apai lai in, Samaria leh Galili gam atawn hi.
heading: Phak Sawm Hihdamna
english: As he was on his way to Jerusalem, he was passing along the borders of Samaria and Galilee.

paite: Huan koi khua hiam a alut ding in, miphak ngenta, sawm in ana dawn uh a, huaite'n gamlatak a dingh in, aw ngaihtak in,
english: As he entered into a certain village, ten men who were lepers met him, who stood at a distance.

paite: "Jesu, Heutupa, ka tung uah zahngai in," achi uhi.
english: They lifted up their voices, saying, “Jesus, Master, have mercy on us!”

paite: Ama'n amau amuh in, akiang uah, "Siampute kiang ah va kilak un," achi hi. Huan hichi ahong hi a, apai lai un ahong siang chiat uhi.
english: When he saw them, he said to them, “Go and show yourselves to the priests.” As they went, they were cleansed.

paite: Huan alak ua khat in dam chih akitheih in, aw ngaihtak a Pathian phat kawm in akik nawnta hi.
english: One of them, when he saw that he was healed, turned back, glorifying God with a loud voice.

paite: Huan akhebul ah abokkhup a, akipahna thu agen hi; huai mi Samari mi ahi.
english: He fell on his face at Jesus’ feet, giving him thanks; and he was a Samaritan.

paite: Huchi in Jesu'n, "Mi sawm hong siangta hilou na hi uh maw? Kuate koi ah?" chi in adong hi.
english: Jesus answered, “Weren’t the ten cleansed? But where are the nine?

paite: "Pathian phat ding a kik nawn, hiai theih louh mi kia lou ngal kuamah muh a om lou uhia?" achi hi.
english: Were there none found who returned to give glory to God, except this foreigner?”

paite: Akiang ah, "Thou inla, paita in; na ginna na dampih hi," achi hi.
english: Then he said to him, “Get up, and go your way. Your faith has healed you.”

paite: Pharisaite'n Pathian lalgam hong tun hun ding adot ziak un, akiang uah, "Pathian lalgam muh theih in ahong tung kei,
heading: Pathian Lalgam Hong Tunna / (Mat 24.23-28; 24.37-41)
english: Being asked by the Pharisees when God’s Kingdom would come, he answered them, “God’s Kingdom doesn’t come with observation;

paite: 'En un, hiai ah hiam, huai ah hiam, achi kei ding uh,' ngai un, Pathian lalgam na lak uah a-om," chi in adawng hi.
english: neither will they say, ‘Look, here!’ or, ‘Look, there!’ for behold, God’s Kingdom is within you.”

paite: Huan nungzuite kiang ah, "Mihing Tapa dam lai ni, ni khat bek na muhnop ni uh ahong om ding a himahleh na mu kei ding uh.
english: He said to the disciples, “The days will come when you will desire to see one of the days of the Son of Man, and you will not see it.

paite: Na kiang uah, 'Hiai ah en un, hiam pam ah en un, ahon chi ding ua; paikhe kei unla, amau leng zui kei un,
english: They will tell you, ‘Look, here!’ or ‘Look, there!’ Don’t go away or follow after them,

paite: van nuai lehlam a khua aphiat a, van nuai lehlam tanpha a avak zel bang in Mihing Tapa ahong pai ni in a-om ding ahi ngal a.'
english: for as the lightning, when it flashes out of one part under the sky, shines to another part under the sky, so will the Son of Man be in his day.

paite: Himahleh huai ma in thil tamtak athuak ding a, hiai khangte deih louh in a-om ding hi.
english: But first, he must suffer many things and be rejected by this generation.

paite: Noah dam lai a thil omdan bang in, Mihing Tapa ahong pai nawn hun chiang in a-om sam ding hi.
english: As it was in the days of Noah, even so it will also be in the days of the Son of Man.

paite: Noah long a alut a, tui ahong let a, avek ua ahihlup khit ni atun masiah, ane un adawn ua, zi leh pasal in akinei uhi.
english: They ate, they drank, they married, and they were given in marriage until the day that Noah entered into the ship, and the flood came and destroyed them all.

paite: Huchibang in Lot dam lai in ahong om a; ane un adawn ua, alei un azuak ua, asuan un alam uhi.
english: Likewise, even as it was in the days of Lot: they ate, they drank, they bought, they sold, they planted, they built;

paite: Himahleh Sodom a kipan Lot apawt ni in van a kipan mei leh kaat azu a, avek un ahihlumta hi.
english: but in the day that Lot went out from Sodom, it rained fire and sulfur from the sky and destroyed them all.

paite: Huchibang in Mihing Tapa ahong kilak ni in a-om ding hi.
english: It will be the same way in the day that the Son of Man is revealed.

paite: "Huai ni in kuamah insung a avan om, ama inn tung a om, va la ding in kum kei heh; lou a om leng pai kei hen.
english: In that day, he who will be on the housetop and his goods in the house, let him not go down to take them away. Let him who is in the field likewise not turn back.

paite: Lot zi theigige un.
english: Remember Lot’s wife!

paite: Kuapeuh ahinna humbit sawm in amansuah ding a kuapeuh ahinna tan in ahumbit ding hi.
english: Whoever seeks to save his life loses it, but whoever loses his life preserves it.

paite: K'on hilh ahi, huai zan in lupna khat ah mi nih alum ding ua, khat lak in a-om ding a, khat nutsiat in a-om ding hi.
english: I tell you, in that night there will be two people in one bed. One will be taken and the other will be left.

paite: Buh gawizan in numei nih a-om ding ua, khat lak in a-om dia, khat nutsiat in a-om ding hi.
english: There will be two grinding grain together. One will be taken and the other will be left.”

paite: Lou ah pasal nih a-om ding ua; khat lak in a-om dia; khat nutsiat in a-om ding," achi hi.
Amau akiang ah, "Toupa, koi ah eita?" chi in adong uhi. Ama'n akiang uah, "Saluang omna peuh ah musane leng akikhawm ding uh," achi hi.
english: They, answering, asked him, “Where, Lord?” He said to them, “Where the body is, there the vultures will also be gathered together.”
